text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
And with that last event, the top overall 
point scorers have been decided!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Sonon Elfie has been clocking phenomenal 
records throughout every stage so far! She 
has splendidly secured her spot in the 
finals!!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
However, Tracen Academy's <chrname> has emerged as 
the top overall scorer at the venue!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
These two are without a doubt the top 
favorites to win! How will their clash in 
the finals turn out?! Keep your eyes glued 
to the trackーー!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaaaah!! I lost!! You're truly 
incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I'll train up again before the tournament 
finals! I'll definitely surpass my limits, 
so please wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And together, let's create the greatest 
final tournament ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sononet Elfie is sure to be our greatest 
rival in the finals as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bracing ourselves together with <chrname>, we 
finally took our steps toward the final 
showdown!
